name: Assassin
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
wakes: Each night except the first, until the ability is used (then the night token is removed).
interaction: Shakes head (no use) or points at one player; told nothing.
drunk_or_poisoned: If drunk or poisoned when used, the kill fails (normal protection and inability to die apply) and the once-per-game ability is still spent.

rulings.text: The kill cannot be prevented by any protection (Monk, Soldier, Tea Lady, Fool, Sailor) unless the Assassin is drunk or poisoned.
A Fool killed by the Assassin dies and stays dead even though the Fool still has their ability.
A drunk Assassin targeting a Moonchild or Goon has no ability: the target does not die; the Goon still turns evil from being chosen.
After use, mark NO ABILITY; the Assassin does not wake again.

test_scenarios.name: kills through Soldier
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Alice Assassin, Bob Soldier, Cara Imp, Dan Chef, Eve Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Imp kills Dan; Assassin chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Dawn: Dan and Bob both died; Alice marked No ability and never woken again.

test_scenarios.name: kills through Monk protection
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Alice Assassin, Bob Monk, Cara Imp, Dan Empath, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Monk protects Dan; Assassin chooses Dan; Imp kills Eve.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Assassin is spent
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Alice Assassin, Bob Soldier, Cara Poisoner, Dan Imp, Eve Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Poisoner poisons Alice; Alice chooses Bob.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob does not die; Alice's ability is used up (No ability).

test_scenarios.name: not woken first night
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Alice Assassin, Bob Imp, Cara Chef.
test_scenarios.expected: Assassin is not woken on night 1.

test_scenarios.name: declines then uses
test_scenarios.setup: Seats: Alice Assassin, Bob Imp, Cara Chef, Dan Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice shakes head. Night 3: Alice chooses Cara.
test_scenarios.expected: Night 2 no Assassin kill; Night 3 Cara dies and Alice is marked No ability.
